description: Run NIST ACVP-format test vectors against the shipping primitives. The vectors are pre-packed into ACVPIN.8xv by the workflow; the calculator-side runner dispatches each vector to the appropriate primitive (AES-128-GCM, SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-256, HKDF-SHA-256, DRBG-SHA-256) and writes responses into ACVPOUT.8xv. The host-side parser then grades responses against the pinned expected outputs.

1.description: ACVP runner completes (all vectors dispatched and ACVPOUT written)
